# netbox_virtual_machine_type (Resource)

A NetBox virtual machine type (virtualization.virtualmachinetype): a reusable sizing template for virtual machines.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/virtualization/virtualmachinetype/):

> A virtual machine type defines a reusable classification and default configuration for [virtual machines](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/virtualization/virtualmachine/).
>
> A type can optionally provide default values for a VM's [platform](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/platform/), vCPU allocation, and memory allocation. When a virtual machine is created with an assigned type, any unset values among these fields will inherit their defaults from the type. Changes made to a virtual machine type do **not** apply retroactively to existing virtual machines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_platform" "test" {
  name = "test-platform"
}

resource "netbox_virtual_machine_type" "test" {
  name                = "test-virtual-machine-type"
  slug                = "test-virtual-machine-type"
  default_platform_id = netbox_platform.test.id
  default_vcpus       = 4
  default_memory      = 8192
  description         = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `default_memory` (Number) Default memory in megabytes.
- `default_platform_id` (Number) Id of the platform virtual machines of this type default to.
- `default_vcpus` (Number) Default number of virtual CPUs.
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_machine_count` (Number) Number of virtual machines of the type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_virtual_machine_type.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_virtual_machine_type.test 123
```
